name: Homing missiles outlive their owner
description: missiles.txt pSrvDoFunc 7 (homing) no longer deletes the missile when its owner dies. The missile keeps homing and deals its damage. A missile whose owner unit no longer exists is still removed.

patches.description: pSrvDoFunc 7 (sub_140458560): NOP the jnz after SUNIT_IsDead(owner) at 0x4585BC that jumped to the remove-missile exit at 0x4586AF.
